decisions.statement: The tracks picked are the tracks the unheard-picking module picks.
An artist is followed where that artist's own page says so.
The playlist is named for the day it was made.
A run picking no track makes no playlist.
A planning run reaches Spotify for nothing.
The answer names the playlist's link.
No playlist made before is read, emptied or added to.

definition: the command making a playlist of what Alan's followed artists made and he has not heard
